title: Getting Started with Web Accessibility: How to Design Evaluations with WCAG and AI
summary: Understand web accessibility through the steps people take to find information and complete tasks. Learn how WCAG 2.2 is structured and how AI can support evaluation, then define the page, user journey and evidence needed to run your first evaluation prompt.

title: Alternative Text: Conveying What an Image Does
summary: Design text alternatives around the information and functional purpose conveyed by non-text content. Learn how to compare images, the DOM, the accessibility tree, and page context, then use a multimodal AI evaluation prompt to record evidence, fixes, and retest items.

title: Recorded Audio and Silent Video: Getting the Same Information Through Different Paths
summary: Distinguish the alternatives needed for prerecorded audio and silent video, and check whether transcripts, step-by-step descriptions, and audio descriptions convey the same information as the originals. Learn the applicability conditions and exceptions, and use an evaluation prompt to organize the materials, time ranges, and evidence provided to multimodal AI.

title: Prerecorded Captions: Conveying Dialogue and Important Sounds
summary: Evaluate the presence, accuracy, speaker identification, and synchronization of captions.

title: Audio Description and Media Alternatives: Explaining Information Visible Only in Video
summary: Convey visual information in prerecorded video through description or a sufficient alternative.

title: Live Captions: Keeping Up with Information in Live Broadcasts
summary: Explore how to check captions for live synchronized media.

title: Prerecorded Audio Description: Making Essential Visual Information Audible
summary: Review the audio description of visual information required at AA.

title: Sign Language Interpretation: Another Language Path for Prerecorded Audio
summary: Distinguish the availability of sign language interpretation from the language expertise needed to evaluate it.

title: Extended Audio Description: Pausing Scenes to Make Time for Explanation
summary: Examine whether extended description is needed for videos with insufficient pauses between speech.

title: Complete Media Alternatives: Following the Entire Video in a Document
summary: Review complete alternatives for prerecorded synchronized media and video-only content.

title: Live Audio Alternatives: Receiving Information Without Hearing It
summary: Prepare equivalent alternatives for live audio-only information.

title: Information and Relationships: Conveying Visual Structure in Code
summary: Convey the relationships in headings, lists, tables, and forms to assistive technologies.

title: Meaningful Sequence: Aligning Visual Order and Reading Order
summary: Evaluate reading order that preserves the meaning of information.

title: Sensory Instructions: Going Beyond “On the Right” or “In Red”
summary: Improve instructions that rely on shape, color, location, or sound.

title: Screen Orientation: Supporting Both Landscape and Portrait
summary: Check for orientation restrictions that are not essential.

title: Input Purpose: Creating Fields That Autocomplete Can Recognize
summary: Make the purpose of fields collecting users’ personal information identifiable in code.

title: Element Purpose: Enabling UI Adaptation to Users’ Needs
summary: Explore the AAA criterion for identifying the purpose of controls, icons, and regions.

title: Color: Not the Only Cue for Information
summary: Convey states and distinctions through means other than color as well.

title: Automatically Playing Audio: Making It Possible to Stop and Adjust
summary: Check the means of controlling audio that plays automatically for more than 3 seconds.

title: Text Contrast: Ensuring Readable Luminance Differences
summary: Calculate contrast for normal and large text according to the applicable conditions.

title: Resizing Text: Preserving Functionality at 200%
summary: Check whether enlarging text causes any loss of content or functionality.

title: Images of Text: Providing Actual Text
summary: Provide adjustable text instead of text embedded in images.

title: Enhanced Text Contrast: A Higher Readability Target
summary: Apply AAA contrast targets to normal and large text.

title: Background Audio: Keeping Speech Clear
summary: Review background audio in prerecorded audio-only content.

title: Text Presentation: Letting Users Choose How They Read
summary: Address line length, line spacing, alignment, and color adjustment together.

title: Stricter Requirements for Images of Text
summary: Examine when images of text are permitted at AAA.

title: Reflow: Reading and Operating Content on Narrow Screens
summary: Reduce two-dimensional scrolling when zooming and using small viewports.

title: Non-Text Contrast: Distinguishing Controls and Shapes
summary: Evaluate luminance differences in controls and graphics that convey information.

title: Text Spacing: Preserving Content When Reading Settings Change
summary: Create interfaces that accommodate changes to letter, word, line, and paragraph spacing.

title: Content on Hover or Focus: Making It Dismissible, Hoverable, and Readable
summary: Check whether tooltips and popovers meet the conditions for dismissal, pointer movement, and persistence.

title: Keyboard: Performing Key Functions Without a Pointer
summary: Check whether functionality can be operated with a keyboard in actual user flows.

title: Keyboard Traps: Being Able to Leave Where You Entered
summary: Check the paths for moving focus out of widgets and dialogs.

title: Keyboard Support Without Exceptions: Extending to the AAA Target
summary: Evaluate keyboard operation of all functionality under stricter requirements.

title: Character Key Shortcuts: Preventing Unintended Activation
summary: Check options for disabling or remapping single-character shortcuts and restricting when they are active.

title: Adjustable Timing: Allowing Time to Read and Enter Information
summary: Evaluate options for turning off, adjusting, or extending time limits, along with the exceptions.

title: Movement and Automatic Updates: Pausing to Read
summary: Check the means of stopping automatic movement and updates.

title: Time-Independent Tasks: Completing Them Without Rushing
summary: Check whether functionality can be completed without time limits at AAA.

title: Interruptions: Deferring Notifications to Stay Focused
summary: Allow users to control interruptions except in emergencies.

title: Re-authentication: Avoiding the Loss of Entered Content
summary: Preserve data and progress during re-authentication after a session expires.

title: Timeout Warnings: Explaining Limits Before Data Entry
summary: Inform users how long they can remain inactive before their data may be lost.

title: Flashing: Quantitatively Checking Hazardous Visual Stimuli
summary: Distinguish flash-count evaluation from evaluation against general and red flash thresholds.

title: Three Flashes: The Stricter AAA Requirement
summary: Review the AAA requirement for the number of flashes per second.

title: Animation from Interactions: Offering a Choice to Reduce Motion
summary: Check whether motion triggered by interaction can be disabled.

title: Bypassing Repeated Blocks: Reaching Main Content Quickly
summary: Check the paths for bypassing repeated navigation.

title: Page Titles: Identifying the Content Currently Open
summary: Review whether document titles describe the topic and purpose.

title: Focus Order: Preserving Meaning Through Interaction
summary: Evaluate whether keyboard navigation order preserves the relationships between information and functionality.

title: Link Purpose in Context: Knowing Where a Link Leads
summary: Evaluate link purpose using both the link and its programmatically associated context.

title: Multiple Ways to Navigate: Reaching the Page You Need
summary: Check for multiple paths to find pages within a site.

title: Headings and Labels: Accurately Describing Content and Purpose
summary: Evaluate whether existing headings and labels use meaningful wording.

title: Visible Focus: Showing the Current Interaction Location
summary: Check the visual indication of keyboard focus in actual interface states.

title: Current Location: Providing Context Within a Site
summary: Review information that indicates where the current page belongs within the site.

title: Conveying Purpose Through the Link Alone: The AAA Requirement
summary: Review the means of identifying a link’s purpose without context.

title: Section Headings: Dividing Long Content for Navigation
summary: Explore the AAA criterion for organizing documents with headings by topic.

title: Obscured Focus: Keeping at Least Part of the Target Visible
summary: Evaluate whether fixed elements completely obscure the focused target at AA.

title: Enhanced Requirements for Unobscured Focus: Showing the Entire Target
summary: Evaluate even partial obscuring of the focused target at AAA.

title: Focus Appearance: Providing Sufficient Area and Contrast
summary: Measure the area and contrast between states of AAA focus indicators.

title: Pointer Gestures: Providing Alternatives to Complex Actions
summary: Check for simple-operation alternatives to multipoint and path-based gestures.

title: Pointer Cancellation: Undoing Unintended Actions
summary: Review the timing of press and release events and the means of canceling or undoing actions.

title: Aligning Visible Labels and Accessible Names
summary: Enable users to find targets by their on-screen labels when using voice control.

title: Motion Actuation: Operating Without Shaking the Device
summary: Check UI alternatives and disabling options for functionality based on device motion.

title: Target Size: Generous Touch Areas at AAA
summary: Review the enhanced target of 44×44 CSS px and its exceptions.

title: Concurrent Input Methods: Using Touch and Keyboard Together
summary: Check whether using one input method restricts the use of another.

title: Dragging: Getting the Same Result Without Dragging
summary: Evaluate single-pointer alternatives to dragging functionality.

title: Target Size: AA Size and Spacing Conditions
summary: Evaluate the 24×24 CSS px requirement and exceptions, including spacing, according to their conditions.

title: Page Language: The Starting Point for Correct Pronunciation
summary: Make the document’s default language programmatically identifiable.

title: Language of Parts: Marking Passages Where the Language Changes
summary: Mark passages in other languages within the body text according to their meaning and the applicable exceptions.

title: Unfamiliar Words: Providing a Way to Find Their Meaning
summary: Review ways to explain technical terms and specialized usage.

title: Abbreviations: Accessing Their Expanded Forms and Meanings
summary: Make it possible to check the expanded forms or meanings of abbreviations.

title: Reading Level: Creating Alternatives to Complex Explanations
summary: Provide easy-to-understand supplementary options for difficult text.

title: Pronunciation: Explaining Readings That Change Meaning
summary: Provide a way to check expressions whose meanings differ depending on pronunciation.

title: Avoiding Interface Changes Triggered by Focus Alone
summary: Check whether merely entering an element causes a change of context.

title: Input Changes: Explaining What Will Happen in Advance
summary: Review advance notice of context changes caused by changing a setting.

title: Consistent Navigation: The Same Paths in the Same Order
summary: Maintain the relative order of repeated navigation structures.

title: Consistent Identification: The Same Names for the Same Functions
summary: Provide consistent names and representations for identical functionality.

title: Change on Request: Predictable Changes of Context
summary: At AAA, allow users to request changes of context or turn them off.

title: Consistent Help: Finding Needed Help in the Same Place
summary: Maintain the relative position of repeated help mechanisms.

title: Error Identification: Explaining What Went Wrong and Where
summary: Describe automatically detected input errors in text.

title: Labels and Instructions: Providing Information Before Input
summary: Explain the required information and format before users enter data.

title: Error Suggestions: Guiding the Next Action
summary: Connect known correction methods to error messages.

title: Important Submissions: Checking Legal, Financial, and Data Changes
summary: Review the means of reversing, checking, and confirming important actions.

title: Context-Sensitive Help: Getting Assistance Where You Are Stuck
summary: Provide help suited to the context of data entry and tasks.

title: Preventing Errors in All Submissions: Extending to AAA
summary: Review the means of reversing, checking, and confirming information submissions in general.

title: Redundant Entry: Not Asking for the Same Information Again Within a Process
summary: Make previously entered information available for reuse or selection.

title: Accessible Authentication: Reducing Reliance on Memory and Puzzles
summary: Review alternatives and assistance mechanisms for cognitive function tests in AA authentication.

title: Enhanced Authentication Requirements: Broader Cognitive Accessibility
summary: Review the permitted alternatives and scope of assistance in AAA authentication.

title: Name, Role, Value: Sharing UI State with Assistive Technologies
summary: Programmatically convey the meaning and state changes of custom controls.

title: Status Messages: Communicating Results Without Moving Focus
summary: Convey task results and progress to assistive technologies.

title: Connecting Accessibility Evaluation with Agents and Services
summary: Design systems that coordinate criterion-specific prompts and connect evidence, improvements, and re-evaluation, along with structures for distributing materials and transitioning to services.
